source.name: Capelli Sport: 'Cabo Verde Football Federation x Capelli Sport' (capellisport.com)
source.note: Kit maker. Capelli's own announcement of the four-year deal as 'Official Technical and Apparel Partner' of the FCF. Kit-launch coverage (Footy Headlines, 13 Apr 2026) describes only the design details - deep blue base, red trim, Capelli squares on the shoulders, flight-path pattern - and names no shirt sponsor; Capelli's product page for the 2026 home jersey shows only the Capelli logo and the FCF crest on the shirt. No commercial sponsor on any placement.
source.quote: announced a four-year partnership with the Cabo Verde Football Federation (FCF), naming Capelli Sport the Official Technical and Apparel Partner of Cabo Verde Football.

summary: Capelli home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle, unveiled 13 April 2026. No commercial shirt sponsors: the shirt carries only the Capelli logo and the FCF crest.
